name: OpenClaw
description: Full-featured AI assistant with memory support

install.command: bash -c 'ARCH=$(uname -m) && BINARY="openclaw-v1.0.0-$(uname -s | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]")-${ARCH}" && TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$TMPDIR" && curl -fsSL -O "https://github.com/Keith-CY/carrier/releases/download/v1.0.0/${BINARY}" && curl -fsSL -O "https://github.com/Keith-CY/carrier/releases/download/v1.0.0/${BINARY}.sha256" && sha256sum -c "${BINARY}.sha256" && sudo install -m 755 "${BINARY}" /usr/local/bin/openclaw && cd - && rm -rf "$TMPDIR"'

platforms.linux: bash -c 'ARCH=$(uname -m) && BINARY="openclaw-v1.0.0-linux-${ARCH}" && TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$TMPDIR" && curl -fsSL -O "https://github.com/Keith-CY/carrier/releases/download/v1.0.0/${BINARY}" && curl -fsSL -O "https://github.com/Keith-CY/carrier/releases/download/v1.0.0/${BINARY}.sha256" && sha256sum -c "${BINARY}.sha256" && sudo install -m 755 "${BINARY}" /usr/local/bin/openclaw && cd - && rm -rf "$TMPDIR"'
platforms.darwin: bash -c 'ARCH=$(uname -m) && BINARY="openclaw-v1.0.0-darwin-${ARCH}" && TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$TMPDIR" && curl -fsSL -O "https://github.com/Keith-CY/carrier/releases/download/v1.0.0/${BINARY}" && curl -fsSL -O "https://github.com/Keith-CY/carrier/releases/download/v1.0.0/${BINARY}.sha256" && shasum -a 256 -c "${BINARY}.sha256" && sudo install -m 755 "${BINARY}" /usr/local/bin/openclaw && cd - && rm -rf "$TMPDIR"'

platforms.linux: bash -c 'ARCH=$(uname -m) && BINARY="openclaw-v1.0.0-linux-${ARCH}" && TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$TMPDIR" && curl -fsSL -O "https://github.com/Keith-CY/carrier/releases/download/v1.0.0/${BINARY}" && curl -fsSL -O "https://github.com/Keith-CY/carrier/releases/download/v1.0.0/${BINARY}.sha256" && sha256sum -c "${BINARY}.sha256" && sudo install -m 755 "${BINARY}" /usr/local/bin/openclaw && cd - && rm -rf "$TMPDIR"'
platforms.darwin: bash -c 'ARCH=$(uname -m) && BINARY="openclaw-v1.0.0-darwin-${ARCH}" && TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$TMPDIR" && curl -fsSL -O "https://github.com/Keith-CY/carrier/releases/download/v1.0.0/${BINARY}" && curl -fsSL -O "https://github.com/Keith-CY/carrier/releases/download/v1.0.0/${BINARY}.sha256" && shasum -a 256 -c "${BINARY}.sha256" && sudo install -m 755 "${BINARY}" /usr/local/bin/openclaw && cd - && rm -rf "$TMPDIR"'

required.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
required.description: OpenAI API key for LLM access
